name: Gracium
description:
Precious ore from the Iceshard Cliffs.
Swathed in frigid air that shines pale
blue when the light catches it.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone Shard
description:
Obtained from destroying a tempered
wound. Has a deep sanguine hue.
Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
description:
Obtained from destroying a tempered
wound. Has a deep sanguine hue.
Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone
description:
Obtained from destroying a tempered
wound. Has a deep sanguine hue.
Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
description:
Obtained from destroying a tempered
wound. Larger than most of its type.
Can be used as a melding material.

name: Wyverian Bloodstone Chunk
description:
Obtained from destroying a tempered
wound. One of the largest of its kind.
Can be used as a melding material.

name: Balahara Black Pearl
description:
A jewel formed from ore that
spent years inside a Balahara.
Bewitchingly beautiful.

name: Guardian Rathalos Ruby
description:
A rare jewel that developed in
a Guardian Rathalos's body. Said
to wield the power of an inferno.

name: Guardian Rathalos Plate
description:
A plate from a Guardian Rathalos.
Strengthened by the flow of energy,
its inherent heat blazes forth.

name: Jin Dahaad Tail
description:
The tail of a Jin Dahaad. Has a
cooling organ that continues to
make cold air even when severed.

name: Expedition Headgear Ticket
description:
A ticket inscribed with the emblem
of the expedition. Give it to the
Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Zoh Shia Certificate S
description:
A Guild certificate awarded to
those who have hunted Zoh
Shia. Used to make equipment.

name: Zoh Shia Crystalscale
description:
A crystallized Zoh Shia scale.
Its dull glow evinces the great
energy it contains.

name: Zoh Shia Layershell
description:
The coiled nature of Zoh Shia's
layered shell looks as though it
protects as much as it constricts.

name: Zoh Shia Stakeclaw
description:
Stake-like Zoh Shia claws extended
by hardened Wylk. The Wylkrystal
growths are eerily uniform.

name: Zoh Shia Crystalhorn
description:
A crystal-coated Zoh Shia horn.
Heavy and wedge-like, as though
it were used to seal something.

name: Zoh Shia Crystaltail
description:
A crystal-covered Zoh Shia tail.
The crystals continue to grow
even after the tail is severed.

name: Faux Whitegleam Orb
description:
An inorganic orb from inside Zoh
Shia. Something wriggles deep
within its elaborate design.

name: Blackember Mass
description:
A small, swollen mass from the
inside of Zoh Shia. It pulses
with an alien-like quality.

name: Mizutsune Certificate S
description:
A Guild certificate awarded to those
who have hunted a Mizutsune.
Used to make equipment.

name: Mizutsune Scale+
description:
A high-quality Mizutsune scale.
Older scales polished over
time can be very valuable.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
description:
High-quality purple Mizutsune
fur. More foam-absorbent than
its lighter counterpart.

name: Mizutsune Claw+
description:
Friction-reducing bubblefoam
helps this deadly claw slice
through prey like sushi.

name: Mizutsune Fin+
description:
A high-quality Mizutsune fin.
Bubblefoam gives it an elegant
pattern prettier than dye.

name: Mizutsune Tail
description:
A flowing Mizutsune tail.
It's prized for its supple
fur and beautiful scales.

name: Bubblefoam+
description:
The top layer of Mizutsune
fluid. Removes impurities
and is used in many rituals.

name: Mizutsune Water Orb
description:
A multicolored orb formed
from a crystallized Mizutsune
scale and bubblefoam.

name: Lagiacrus Certificate S
description:
A Guild certificate awarded to
those who have hunted a Lagiacrus.
Used to make equipment.

name: Lagiacrus Scale+
description:
A high-quality Lagiacrus scale.
Both its robustness and beautiful
blue hue are truly breathtaking.

name: Lagiacrus Hide+
description:
A fine hide taken from a Lagiacrus.
It's quite strong and immensely
flexible.

name: Lagiacrus Shockspike
description:
The spike from a Lagiacrus's back.
Safe to handle since it's used to
release electricity, not generate it.

name: Lagiacrus Horn+
description:
A fine horn taken from a strong
Lagiacrus. Merely having one on
hand is enough to draw attention.

name: Lagiacrus Tail
description:
The tail of a Lagiacrus. Used not
only in weaponcraft, a certain
village also considers it a delicacy.

name: Lagiacrus Claw+
description:
The sharp claw of a Lagiacrus.
Though unremarkable at a glance,
a single strike from it can be fatal.

name: Lagiacrus Sapphire
description:
A deep azure gem formed inside
a Lagiacrus. The sound of rippling
water can be heard from its core.

name: Omega Data 1.0
description:
Data left behind by Omega Planetes.
Includes records of the countless
battles it has had with various heroes.

name: Omega Screw
description:
A puzzling screw from Omega Planetes.
Made with such precision and
complexity that it cannot be replicated.

name: Omega Spring
description:
A puzzling spring from Omega Planetes.
Its detailed makeup allows it to
bear unusually heavy loads.

name: Omega Pedal
description:
A puzzling pedal from Omega Planetes.
Its incredible technological capabilities
allow it to move many parts at once.

name: Omega Lens
description:
A puzzling lens from Omega Planetes.
It's said that peering through it allows
you to see into a new dimension.

name: Omega Axle
description:
A puzzling axle from Omega Planetes.
Interdimensional technology allows
it to rotate with immense force.

name: Omega Nodule
description:
A puzzling core from Omega Planetes.
It pulsates with heat, as if still active even
after being removed from the main body.

name: Omega Data 2.0
description:
Battle data left behind by Omega Planetes
(Savage). Includes records of the fierce
battles it has had with various heroes.

name: Gogmazios Certificate S
description:
A Guild certificate awarded to those
who have hunted a Gogmazios.
Used to make equipment.

name: Gogmazios Rampart
description:
A scale covered in the hardened
drakesbone oil Gogmazios
continually secretes.

name: Gogmazios Fortalice
description:
A carapace studded with weapons
and armaments. No halfhearted
attack can so much as faze it.

name: Gogmazios Lacerator
description:
A twisted blade slicked with
blood and oil. Its dull edge
crushes instead of cutting.

name: Gogmazios Shredders
description:
Red-hot claws the Gogmazios
uses to cruelly sear prey within
its long arms' reach.

name: Gogmazios Fiberwing
description:
A great wing too tattered to
raise winds, sending instead
vicious splatters of oil.

name: Gogmazios Thorntail
description:
A long, vicious tail lined with
countless spines. Strikes fear
into all who look upon it.

name: Wartorn Dragongem
description:
A precious gem formed within a
Gogmazios's body. At its core is a
firestorm capable of consuming all.

name: Heavy Drakesbone Oil
description:
Hazardous fluid that courses
through the Gogmazios's body
and explodes at high heat.

name: Mutated Armament
description:
A weapon material that has been
altered by exposure to drakesbone
oil. Needs to be appraised.

name: Rey Dau Certificate γ
description:
A Guild certificate for hunting
an Arch-tempered Rey Dau.
Used to make equipment.

name: Uth Duna Certificate γ
description:
A Guild certificate for hunting
an Arch-tempered Uth Duna.
Used to make equipment.

name: Nu Udra Certificate γ

Used to make equipment.

Used to make equipment.

name: Arkveld Certificate γ
description:
A Guild certificate for hunting
an Arch-tempered Arkveld.
Used to make equipment.

name: SF6 Ticket
description:

strength. Give it to the Smithy

name: Assisted Combo: Akuma
description:
Akuma's Ansatsuken fighting style.
Once activated, combine different
inputs to unleash fearsome combos.

name: Gou Hadoken
description:
Akuma's signature Hadoken, which
can be fired from your slinger.
Hold the input to charge.

name: Drive Impact
description:
The fierce Oni Goroshi attack.
Use it on wounds or weak points
to unleash the Shun Goku Satsu.

name: Barrel Bowling Voucher
description:
A voucher for a chance to play
a Grand Hub mini-game. Has
a whimsical DIY look.

name: Blossomdance Voucher

the Blossomdance. Exchange
it for a festive meal.

a festive meal.

name: ICHIRAN Order Form
description:
A special order form received from
the ICHIRAN Clerk, good for one
delicious bowl of ICHIRAN ramen.

name: Amstrigian Ticket
description:
A ticket depicting the ecology
of Amstrigian. Give it to the
Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Sealed Dragon Cloth
description:
A cloth used to seal the corpse
of a dreaded elder dragon. Truth
or lie, the ominousness is palatable.

name: Necklace Ticket
description:
A ticket depicting designs for a
striking necklace. Give it to the
Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Doshaguma Sketch
description:
A ticket with detailed sketches of
a Doshaguma's head. Give it to
the Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Toe Bean Ticket
description:
A ticket stamped with what appears
to be a Palico's pawprint. Give it to
the Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Skull Ticket
description:
A ticket depicting a skull.
Give it to the Smithy to get
special equipment.

name: Songbird Sketch
description:
A ticket depicting a Hymstrigian.
Give it to the Smithy to get
special equipment.

name: Well-done Steak Recipe Book
description:
A recipe for a special well-done
steak. Give it to the Smithy to
get special equipment... But why?

name: Orion Ticket
description:
A ticket depicting a warm-looking
set of armor. Give it to the Smithy
to get special equipment.

name: Wudwud Likey-like
description:
Junk that a certain Wudwud seems
to "likey-like." Give it to the Smithy
for special...equipment?

name: Felyne Wanted Poster
description:
A document depicting a notorious
Lynian. Give it to the Smithy
to get special equipment.

name: Blossom Barrel Bomb
description:
A large barrel bomb from the
Blossomdance. Explodes with
a flurry of flower petals.

name: Beach Barrel Bomb
description:
A large barrel bomb from the
Flamefete. Explodes into a
colorful bouquet of fireworks.

name: Spectral Barrel Bomb
description:
A large barrel bomb from the
Dreamspell. Releases something
when it detonates...

name: Wudwud Barrel Bomb
description:
A large barrel bomb from
Lumenhymn. Explodes with
a bunch of raucous Wudwuds!

name: Pinnacle Coin
description:
A commemorative coin bestowed on
hunters who have mastered the craft.
The value of its sheen? Priceless.

name: Kunafa Meal Voucher
description:
Exchange this voucher in the
Grand Hub Canteen for one order
of the Kunafa regional meal.

name: Helix Piercing Pod
description:
Slinger ammo usable even
underwater that deals piercing
damage on impact.

name: Bladescale Pod
description:
Slinger ammo that lodges into a
target for continuous damage. Can
be attacked for additional damage.

name: Shield Generator
description:
Slinger ammo that creates a
shield where it lands, blocking
monster attacks for a while.

name: The Blackest Night
description:
Reduces health and creates a
barrier around you. Counterattacks
when the barrier fades or is destroyed.

name: Pom Motif
description:
A spell that paints a pom,
rendering a rain of poms that
deal damage to monsters nearby.

name: Wing Motif
description:
A spell that paints a pair of
windborne wings that deal
damage to monsters nearby.

name: Mog of the Ages
description:
Render your moogle portrait
to life, dealing magical damage
to enemies in a straight line.

name: Compact Anti-Wyvern Gun
description:
Load it into the Slinger for firing.
An energy-charge mechanism
allows you to boost its power.

name: Soul of the Pictomancer
description:
A crystal containing the memories
and creativity of a pictomancer.
Allows you to use pictomancy.

name: Glowing Stone
description:
Contains some secret power.
Needs to be appraised in order
to be equipped as a talisman.

name: Timeworn Charm
description:
Contains an awesome power.
Needs to be appraised in order
to be equipped as a talisman.

name: Silver Talisman Ticket
description:
A ticket used by Wyverians.
Hand it over when melding
talismans to get a discount.

name: Gold Talisman Ticket
description:
A ticket used by Wyverians.
Hand it over when melding
talismans to get a great discount.

name: Battle-tempered Emblem
description:
Proof that you've hunted a fierce
monster. Has great value when used
for melding, smelting, or upgrades.

name: Secret Stash
description:
A pouch carried by a mischievous
Lynian. Full of miscellaneous junk.

name: Round Acorn
description:
A perfectly round acorn. It's
a Felyne's beloved treasure.

name: Pawprint Stamp
description:
Lynian currency, stamped with
a pawprint. Can be redeemed
at the Provisions Stockpile.

name: Azure Stargem
description:
Special reward for overcoming
the USJ challenge. Give it to the
Smithy to get special equipment.

name: Insect Husk
description:
The remains of a dead insect.
Doesn't seem very useful.

name: Felyne Fur Ruby
description:
A rare ruby carried by Lynians.
It can be used as a material at
Azuz's Smelting Foundry.

name: Royal Felyne Emblem
description:
Proof of service to a royal
lineage. Give it to the Smithy
to get special equipment.

name: Master Craftsman's Blueprint
description:
A master craftsman's blueprint for
a new weapon. The Smithy can make
something remarkable with this.

name: Rompopolo Sketch
description:
A ticket with intricate sketches of
a Rompopolo's head. Give it to
the Smithy to get special equipment.
